visualReview.method: Actual view_image inspection of all10 final reference screenshots and5 final Python-card screenshots, each separately. All15 new images differ from old candidate captures and were actually re-viewed.
visualReview.findings: Original titles and credits complete and readable, only title/credit on references, all original full Python programs visible, no caption overlay. New upstream icon/GitHub header retained and strict mobile overflow check passes.

limitations: Chromium viewport emulation, not physical mobile/iOS Safari.
Only the five changed appendices play at 1x on desktop; no duplicate mobile plays or prior-batch media GETs.
Playback is muted; no human audio/ASR claim. Complete body preservation uses the baseline-SHA-bound full media receipts.
390px embedded video remains small; full reading is inspected in actual native fullscreen at 844×390 and article text.
Citation clicks prevent navigation; source verification is a separate record.
scope: Five batch-10 first appendices; derived pages, title/credit-only cards, 5 desktop 1x Python-card-to-reference endings and 5 native mobile fullscreen cases. No prior-batch media or old appendix proof.
